# SD WebUI wire fixtures

Retrieved on 2026-08-05 from first-party documentation:

- AUTOMATIC1111 Stable Diffusion WebUI API: https://github.com/AUTOMATIC1111/stable-diffusion-webui/wiki/API
- Stable Diffusion WebUI Forge compatibility and API status: https://github.com/lllyasviel/stable-diffusion-webui-forge
- ADetailer REST API: https://github.com/Bing-su/adetailer/wiki/REST-API
- ControlNet Web API: https://github.com/Mikubill/sd-webui-controlnet/wiki/API

The fixtures retain only fields consumed or emitted by TavernCanvas. Prompts, credentials, host URLs, and response metadata were replaced with deterministic test values. A running WebUI's generated `/docs` endpoint remains authoritative for fields supplied by that installation.
